messages:
ChatCompletionMessage(content='Here’s a quick rundown of the **newly available functions** you can call from this session:

| Function | Purpose | Key Parameters |
|----------|---------|----------------|
| **add_to_watchlist** | Add a stock symbol to your watchlist | `stock` |
| **cancel_order** | Cancel an existing order | `order_id` |
| **filter_stocks_by_price** | Filter a list of symbols by a price range | `stocks`, `min_price`, `max_price` |
| **fund_account** | Deposit money into your trading account | `amount` |
| **get_account_info** | Retrieve your account balance, holdings, etc. | – |
| **get_available_stocks** | Get all stock symbols in a specified sector | `sector` |
| **get_current_time** | Fetch the current system time | – |
| **get_order_details** | Get details for a specific order | `order_id` |
| **get_order_history** | Retrieve your past order IDs | – |
| **get_symbol_by_name** | Convert a company name to its ticker symbol | `name` |
| **get_transaction_history** | Pull transaction records between dates | `start_date`, `end_date` |
| **get_watchlist** | View all symbols currently on your watchlist | – |
| **notify_price_change** | Alert when a stock’s price changes beyond a threshold | `stocks`, `threshold` |
| **place_order** | Submit a new buy/sell order | `order_type`, `symbol`, `price`, `amount` |
| **remove_stock_from_watchlist** | Delete a symbol from your watchlist | `symbol` |
| **trading_get_login_status** | Check if you’re logged in | – |
| **trading_login** | Log into the trading system | `username`, `password` |
| **trading_logout** | Log out of the trading system | – |

| **get_account_info** | Retrieve your account balance, holdings, etc. | – |
| **get_available_stocks** | Get all stock symbols in a specified sector | `sector` |

ChatCompletionMessage(content='Here’s a quick rundown of the **newly available functions** you can call from this session:

| Function | Purpose | Key Parameters |
|----------|---------|----------------|
| **add_to_watchlist** | Add a stock symbol to your watchlist | `stock` |
| **cancel_order** | Cancel an existing order | `order_id` |
| **filter_stocks_by_price** | Filter a list of symbols by a price range | `stocks`, `min_price`, `max_price` |
| **fund_account** | Deposit money into your trading account | `amount` |
| **get_account_info** | Retrieve your account balance, holdings, etc. | – |
| **get_available_stocks** | Get all stock symbols in a specified sector | `sector` |
| **get_current_time** | Fetch the current system time | – |
| **get_order_details** | Get details for a specific order | `order_id` |
| **get_order_history** | Retrieve your past order IDs | – |
| **get_symbol_by_name** | Convert a company name to its ticker symbol | `name` |
| **get_transaction_history** | Pull transaction records between dates | `start_date`, `end_date` |
| **get_watchlist** | View all symbols currently on your watchlist | – |
| **notify_price_change** | Alert when a stock’s price changes beyond a threshold | `stocks`, `threshold` |
| **place_order** | Submit a new buy/sell order | `order_type`, `symbol`, `price`, `amount` |
| **remove_stock_from_watchlist** | Delete a symbol from your watchlist | `symbol` |
| **trading_get_login_status** | Check if you’re logged in | – |
